findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the hand washing sink in the infant room to contain a paintbrush in the sink basin. CORRECTED- the paint brush was removed from the sink. Ensure hand washing sinks are used for hand washing only. A blocked sink/ a sink used for other purposes may deter frequent hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [Pf]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed ambient thermometer to be missing from the refrigerator in the infant room. CORRECTED- an ambient thermometer was placed in the door. Ensure all cold holding units contain an ambient thermometer placed in the warmest part of the unit to ensure temperature control for food safety (TCS) foods are held at or below 41F.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: Inspector observed handle of serving utensil in the oranges. Gloves are worn when serving but still food must be protected from the handle. The serving time was at the end. Breakfast is from 8:30am to 10am. The few oranges remaining were discarded. The kitchen staff was reminded of the rule. They said that they usually use a smaller bowl and the handle does not usually does not come into contact with the food. 

FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.
